A '''Separatist outpost''' was located on the planet of [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]], composed of two [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[XT Beetle Transport/Legends|XT Beetle Transports]]. The [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s of this outpost disturbed the [[Talz/Legends|natives]], so the Talz eventually [[Skirmish on Orto Plutonia/Legends|destroyed]] all of them, then posting their heads on spears at the entrance of the transport.
